summary: Gracefully closes a socket handle passed by pointer. If the handle is not INVALID_SOCKET (-1) and the graceful flag is set, calls shutdown(SD_SEND) and drains pending data via recv until it returns 0 or an error, then calls closesocket and marks the stored handle as -1 (INVALID_SOCKET). Returns the closesocket result.

operations.description: Read the socket handle from *a1 into the result register before any state change.
If *a1 equals -1 (INVALID_SOCKET), the socket is already closed and the function returns without acting.
Graceful path only runs when flag a2 is non-zero and shutdown() returns 0.
Call shutdown on the socket to disable further sends.
Drain loop: call recv(*a1, buf, 256, 0) repeatedly until it returns -1 or 0, discarding any remaining inbound data.
Call closesocket(*a1) to close the socket handle.
Write -1 (INVALID_SOCKET) back to *a1 to mark the handle closed.
